title: Ask reading questions
subtitle: Who acts? What is marked? What does the clause add?
overview: Read in an order that protects you from guesswork: finite verb, subject, marked phrases, dependent clauses, then translation.
Use a lexicon only after you have identified the form you are looking up.

sections.title: A reusable question set
rows: What is affected / what is seen?
To whom does he or she give?
What relationship does the preposition add?

items.grc: οἱ πιστεύοντες εἰς αὐτὸν ἔχουσιν ζωήν.
items.en: Those believing in him have life.

items.grc: ἐν τῇ χάριτι τοῦ θεοῦ μένομεν.
items.en: We remain in the grace of God.
